script.title: WRONG ORDER AT THE FOOD COURT
script.story_hook: A mix-up at the counter tests everyone's patience.
script.intro_zh: 櫃台出錯餐，考驗每個人的耐心。
script.welcome_en: Hello everyone! Today we fix a wrong food-court order.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好！今天來處理美食街上錯餐的狀況。
script.outro: Mistakes happen everywhere. Now you know what to say!
script.outro_zh: 哪裡都會出錯，現在你知道該怎麼說啦！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's practice. Say each line after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 來練習吧，跟著我一句一句說。
script.char_a_description: a busy woman in her late thirties with a chestnut bob tucked behind one ear, wearing a rust-colored linen shirt and a smartwatch, balancing two paper drink cups
script.char_b_description: a tired teenage boy around seventeen with a mop of curly brown hair, wearing a bright red fast-food visor and matching polo shirt, wiping the counter with a gray cloth
script.youtube_title: 【🍜🥡美食街實況英文】「這碗不是我的！」收據不見也能換餐的關鍵句型｜聽完就能用｜🎧Food Court English
script.youtube_title_en: "On the House" — Fixing a Wrong Food-Court Order
script.youtube_description:
拿到的餐跟點的不一樣，收據又不在手上，該怎麼辦？這集 18 句美食街對話教你禮貌換餐：說明錯誤、用名字查單、確認付款、耐心等待。全美式日常口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口反應。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Wrong tray, no receipt, growing hunger — sounds stressful, right? In this 18-line food-court scene you'll learn to report the mix-up politely, look up the order by name, confirm the payment, and swap trays calmly. Everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section so the phrases stick.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍜美食街英文｜說明錯餐・報名查單・確認付款｜聽完就會換餐｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
餐端錯人了，收據又剛好不在手上？
在擁擠的美食街，該怎麼禮貌又快速地換餐？

這一集帶大家走進午餐尖峰的美食街櫃台，跟著顧客從說明錯誤、用名字查單、確認付款，到順利換餐，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🍱 說明錯餐：例如「this isn't my order.」、「Something got mixed up.」
🔎 查單確認：例如「I can check the register by name.」、「It's under Gomez.」
💳 付款與補救：例如「No double charge, promise.」、「On the house, sorry again!」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次遇到上錯餐，別緊張，用英文好好說清楚！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a chicken rice tray at the counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, this isn't my order. Something got mixed up.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɪs ɪzənt maɪ ˈɔrdər ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɡɑt ˈmɪkst ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這不是我點的餐，好像搞混了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, sorry about that. What did you order?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt wʌt dɪd ju ˈɔrdər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The spicy beef bowl, but this is chicken rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈspaɪsi bif boʊl bʌt ðɪs ɪz ˈtʃɪkən raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 是麻辣牛肉丼，但這盤是雞肉飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have the receipt with you, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ðə rɪˈsit wɪð ju pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請問收據有帶在身邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... my friend took it to grab napkins, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ frɛnd tʊk ɪt tə ɡræb ˈnæpkɪnz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 呃…老實說，我朋友拿走收據去拿餐具了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, I can check the register by name.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz aɪ kæn tʃɛk ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər baɪ neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我可以用名字查系統訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's under Gomez, order placed around noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈʌndər ˈɡomez ˈɔrdər pleɪst əˈraʊnd nun/
dialogue.zh: 訂在 Gomez 名下，大約中午點的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it! Gomez, spicy beef, extra sauce?
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ˈɡomez ˈspaɪsi bif ˈɛkstrə sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 找到了！Gomez，麻辣牛肉、加醬，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that's the one. Has it come up yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts ði wʌn hʌz ɪt kʌm ʌp jɛt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet. Beef station is slammed, ten minutes tops.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt bif ˈsteɪʃən ɪz slæmd tɛn ˈmɪnɪts tɑps/
dialogue.zh: 還沒，牛肉檔口忙翻了，最多十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's okay. Can I keep the chicken for now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts oʊˈkeɪ kæn aɪ kip ðə ˈtʃɪkən fɔr naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。這盤雞肉飯我可以先留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it's already paid... wait, let me check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɪts ɔlˈrɛdi peɪd weɪt lɛt mi tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，這盤已經付過了……等等，我查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the ticket says cash, but I paid by card.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ˈtɪkɪt sez kæʃ bʌt aɪ peɪd baɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 單上寫現金，但我其實是刷卡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, card paid already. No double charge, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt kɑrd peɪd ɔlˈrɛdi noʊ ˈdʌbəl tʃɑrdʒ ˈprɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 確認了，刷卡已付款，不會重複扣款，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, thank you. Your system is a lifesaver.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju θæŋk ju jʊr ˈsɪstəm ɪz ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 呼，謝謝你，你們的系統真是救星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your beef bowl, extra sauce, fresh made.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz jʊr bif boʊl ˈɛkstrə sɔs frɛʃ meɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這是您的牛肉丼，加醬、現做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome! And the chicken? Should I pay for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔsəm ænd ðə ˈtʃɪkən ʃʊd aɪ peɪ fɔr ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！那雞肉飯呢？我要另外付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the house, sorry again! Enjoy your lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə haʊs ˈsɑri əˈɡɛn ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jʊr lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那盤招待你，真的很抱歉！午餐慢用。
